plain: A secret US agency for underwater spying, the National Underwater Reconnaissance Office or NURO, is said to have been set up in 1969. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says it was "established in 1969 and still has not been disclosed to this day." Michels describes it himself as "the little brother" of the National Reconnaissance Office, which runs US spy satellites, saying it "is now public" but little is known about it. On another episode he credits a man named Bob Ballard with founding it; if true, it would mean the government has long watched the oceans in secret, where some think unexplained craft also go.
